notes.title: Watch Vreal videos on the Web!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re experimenting with a fun new feature today: You can now watch Vreal videos in a web browser by visiting [url=https://vreal.net/watch]https://vreal.net/watch[/url]! 

Here’s how it works: After you watch and/or publish a recording in the Vreal app, you’ll notice some share buttons for Facebook, Twitter, and Reddit. Clicking those buttons will generate a post with a custom URL so that people can watch it in their browser on their PCs. And just like in the app, viewers can use their mouse and WASD keys to move around inside the video.

This feature is a work-in-progress; here are the current known issues:

[list]
[*] Some older recordings do not support web streaming. You’ll be able to tell if a recording is supported by whether or not the share icons are visible on the content page. 
[*] We currently support web streaming for the following titles: GORN, Tilt Brush, Blocks, Fantastic Contraption, Eleven: Table Tennis, Catch and Release, PlanTechtor, Jet Island, Virtual Virtual Reality, Cat Sorter VR, Cloudlands, and Totally Accurate Battle Simulator.
[*] Social features (friends and parties) are not currently available in the Web version.
[*] While most browsers are supported, we highly recommend using Chrome for the best experience. Mobile browsers are not supported. We recommend at least a 20 megabit Internet connection for the best performance.
[*] Server availability is limited and you may be placed in a queue if our servers are full.
[*] An updated list of known issues can be found on our user wiki, [url=https://vreality.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/205914142/Known+Issues]here[/url].
[/list]

We appreciate your support! If you have any questions, or if you want to suggest a new game for us, or if you have an excellent feature idea, head over to [url=http://support.vreal.net/]http://support.vreal.net/[/url]. If you’re looking for a rad group of content creators, [url=http://discord.gg/vreal]join our Discord[/url].

notes.content:
Today’s update includes a huge visual overhaul of the Vreal app, as well as major improvements. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32932156/b20e46718d46b8ee4b19d39640444eaf079bfe90.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The app is now resizable and works with a wider range of monitor resolutions and zoom levels. Finally you can soak up all of those 4k pixels with Vreal!

[*] An updated list of known issues can be found on our user wiki, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://vreality.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/205914142/Known+Issues]here[/url].

notes.title: Now supporting Totally Accurate Battle Simulator (TABS); our first non-VR game!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32932156/a497b578b6e4d9306e8f460106d1d4d8b75dc192.png[/img]

Are you TOTALLY prepared for the news we have to share? Would it be ACCURATE to say you’re sick of all the puns we are always sharing? Well, we hope you’re ready for BATTLE because we can’t stop won’t stop. It may seem like we’re just pun robots, but we promise this isn’t a SIMULATOR.

Okay okay, enough of that. Big news today! Vreal has added our first ever non-VR game: Totally Accurate Battle Simulator (TABS) from developers Landfall. TABS is currently in Early Access on Steam. This game is incredibly fun to play, from the campaigns to the units to the maps, it’s full of character that is unforgettable.

Before you alt-tab away, there’s a couple things you should know. TABS content is only available to watch in desktop mode, as it’s not a VR game. 

Updates:

[list]
[*] Support for our first non-VR title, Totally Accurate Battle Simulator, is now live!
[*] You can now switch between VR and Desktop mode without ever closing the Vreal app.
[*] We now highlight popular content, based on when it was posted, views and hearts the content has received. Popular content is displayed with a fire icon.
[/list]

If you have any questions, or if you want to suggest a new feature, head over to [url=http://support.vreal.net][/url].

Known Issues:
[list]
[*] When watching in a party, all members will be forced to watch in 2D
[*] Only single-level commenting is currently supported (nested replies and deletion are coming in the future)
[*] We’re still adjusting the popular content algorithm, so you may see that changing a bit in the next couple weeks.
[*] An updated list of known issues can be found on our user wiki, [url=https://vreality.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/205914142/Known+Issues]here[/url].
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing Desktop Mode: A new way to watch VR content
notes.content:
HUGE update for y’all today: We’ve added a brand new feature that allows everyone to watch their favorite VR content creators in Vreal - no VR headset required! (WHAAAAT?) 

Introducing [b]Desktop Mode[/b], an immersive way to experience VR content made in Vreal. Using the WASD keys and your mouse, you can move around anywhere within the game, giving you full control of where you want to watch from; it’s your very own spectator mode for VR game content in Vreal.
 
Here’s our dev update video that explains all the things! 

https://youtu.be/IARueR6ENXU

BTW, recording VR content in VR requires a VR headset. If you’re a content creator passionate about building the VR community, [url=http://www.discord.gg/vreal]please join our Discord[/url].

Our supported VR games now include [i]Gunheart[/i], [i]Tilt Brush[/i], [i]GORN[/i], [i]Blocks[/i], [i]Fantastic Contraption[/i], [i]SUPERHOT VR[/i], and [i]Hot dogs, Horseshoes, and Hand Grenades[/i]. More games are coming, and VERY SOON! *wink wink*

[b]Update notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Introducing Desktop mode: Watch recordings without the need for a VR headset
[*] When launching Vreal from Steam, you can choose to launch the app in VR mode or Desktop Mode. Note: recording is only available in VR Mode
[/list]

[b]When watching content in Desktop Mode, use the following controls to navigate:[/b]
[list][*] WASD - 4-directional movement
[*] Q and E - move down and up
[*] Spacebar - automatic teleport to player
[*] Esc - Opens the controls menu; in Gunheart, closes the recording
[*] P - pause recording
[*] Move mouse to look around
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Performance issues caused by leaving selfie cameras open have been fixed. 
[*] Fixed custom thumbnails sometimes not applying when publishing a stream. 
[*] An updated list of known issues can be found on our [url=https://vreality.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/205914142/Known+Issues]user wiki[/url].
[/list]

notes.title: Party time! Excellent!
notes.content:
The holiday season is upon us, and we couldn’t think of a better time to roll out improvements to the social panel in the Vreal app. HOORAY! The next time you fire up Vreal, you’ll notice the following updates:
[list]
[*] It's easier to see which of your Steam friends have Vreal. Even if you are friends on Steam, you'll still need to connect through Vreal in order to party up.
[*] You can now accept all (YAY!) or decline all (sad panda) friend requests and party invites. 
[*] Animated notifications for friends and parties now live inside the social panel.
[*] Party invites are now formatted like friend requests. 
[*] The party leader now has a crown icon. The party leader is the person in the group who selects what you are going to watch.
[*] We made a visual overhaul of how you see your offline friends, so it’s clearer who is online and available to join a party. 
[*]When creating a party, we show you empty slots to let you know how many remaining invites you have left.
[*] We have new icons for the friend list, add friends, and party management sections on the social panel.
[*] The social panel no longer expands to take up the full screen.
[/list]

If you have any questions, or if you want to suggest a new feature, head over to [url=http://support.vreal.net/]support.vreal.net[/url].

-The Vreal team

notes.title: This update is super packed and super... hot!
notes.content:
Hey folks! We've got a HUGE update for you today. The latest [i][b]SUPERHOT VR[/b][/i] release on Steam is now available for recording in the Vreal app. And after you publish that first speed run, you can [b]upload your own custom thumbnail (!!)[/b] for your content. We've also [b]overhauled how audio is recorded[/b] across all games; the player's voice sounds so much smoother. We've implemented a way for you to add friends to Vreal through your Steam friends list, too.

We squashed some bugs (thank you for your bug reports!) and made a ton of other improvements. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rnUzO0tplgA]Check out our dev update video here[/url] and see below for the biggest updates and bug fixes in this release:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32932156/f9e809bf3553891993c930a590a4a05608e533f7.png[/img]

[u][b]Updates:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added support for [i]SUPERHOT VR[/i]: Record content in [i]SUPERHOT VR[/i]! Make sure you’ve got the latest version of the game first, and then apply the Vreal mod. 
[*] You can now upload custom thumbnails for your content! We accept .jpg and .png file types with a maximum size of 2MB, and a minimum resolution of 800 x 450. If your thumbnail doesn’t fit, the Vreal app will crop it for you.
[*] There’s been a massive update when recording the player’s voice. Not only has the audio quality vastly improved, but players can now talk through loading screens while they are recording content. 
[*] There are now separate volume sliders for the player’s voice, the game’s audio, and the party volume when watching content. Right click on the Vreal icon in the windows tray to find these. 
[*] Introducing Steam friends integration! You’re now able to send your friends on Steam a friend invite on Vreal, making it much easier to put together parties with friends you already have. And if your Steam friends don’t yet have Vreal, you can invite them to download it through the app. Please note your friends will need VR to watch content with you in the Vreal app.
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The Vreal app will now let you know when there’s a version mismatch between a Steam game that you can create content with and your Vreal modded version.
[*] Your friends’ status when they are watching a stream is now displayed correctly. 
[*] We’ve improved the spectator spawn positions across all supported games. 
[*] Fixed several issues with teleporting across areas and teleporting to the player.
[/list]

[u][b]Known issues:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] An updated list of known issues can be found on our user wiki, [url=https://vreality.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/205914142/Known+Issues]here[/url].
[*] As of this release, we are temporarily retiring support for [i]Arizona Sunshine[/i] and [i]Surgeon Simulator: Experience Reality[/i] as we make room for new titles.
[*] We appreciate your support! If you have any questions, or if you want to suggest a new feature, head over to [url=http://support.vreal.net/]support.vreal.net[/url]. You’re welcome to [url=http://discord.gg/vreal]join our Discord[/url] to chat with Vreal staff and meet new Vreal friends!
[/list]

notes.title: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes, Hand Grenades, and Vreal!
notes.content:
Howdy folks! We've added another popular VR game to the Vreal platform: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades! We can't wait to see what content you're able to come up with! Without further adieu, here are the biggest updates for this release:

[b]Updates:[/b]
[list][*]Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades is now supported! Huzzah!
[*]The modding animation got a makeover and it is now much more obvious when we are modding supported titles. 
[*]We cleared up the publishing process by showing a success message if you click publish and stay on the same page. [/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]When you change the ‘cameras visible’ setting to hide your cameras, your party members’ cameras are now also hidden. 
[*]Some users were able to publish content twice; this is now fixed.
[*]Fonts now display properly when watching [i]Fantastic Contraption[/i] streams. 
[*]An updated list of known issues can be found on our user wiki, [url=https://vreality.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/205914142/Current+Known+Issues] here[/url].

notes.title: Fan-freaking-tastic!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve got a [b]fantastic[/b] update for you. We’ve just added support for [i]Fantastic Contraption[/i] to the Vreal app! If you own [i]Fantastic Contraption[/i], you can create your own recordings in Vreal. We also made a bunch of updates to the selfie cam; thanks to everyone who submitted bug reports.

More games are coming; we read every comment and appreciate your feedback!

[b]Here are the latest updates:[/b][list]
[*]Fantastic Contraption is now supported!
[*]All menu panels in VR can now be moved with the laser pointer.
[*]The time remaining in the current stream can now be seen on the menu in VR.[/list]
[b]General bug fixes:[/b][list]
[*]Fixed a couple bugs with the selfie camera and with selfie camera photos.
[*]We’ve updated the teleporter so that if you point down closer to your feet it will let you "drop down" another level. This fixes the issue with being unable to teleport back to the arena in [i]GORN[/i] after going up into the stands.
[*]Hover text is now shown for disabled buttons as well as in VR.
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b][list]
[*]An updated list of known issues can be found on our user wiki, [url=https://vreality.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/205914142/Known+Issues]here[/url].
[/list]

notes.title: SHOW US WHAT YOU GOT!
notes.content:
If you've watched some VR recordings in Vreal, and you thought to yourself... "I could do that." SHOW US WHAT YOU GOT! If you own [i]Tilt Brush[/i], [i]GORN[/i], or [i]Blocks[/i], you can now create your own VR recordings in Vreal.

We have but one humble request: remember us when you're internet famous in Virtual Reality.

We are evaluating the games that you've requested and support for more games is on the way. We appreciate your patience; keep the suggestions coming! :) 

In the meantime, here are the latest updates: [list]
[*][i]Blocks[/i] by Google is now available!
[*]Content creation is open to all users!
[*]Our supported titles include: [i]Tilt Brush[/i], [i]Blocks[/i], and [i]GORN[/i]. As long as you own a currently supported title, you can record a stream. 
[*]Before you can publish your first recording, you need to verify your email address.
[*]We’ve updated [i]GORN[/i] to use the latest and greatest bits.
[*]We've included updates to the Vreal app UI
[*]The "Record" drop-down menu serves as a quick launch menu, and shows the games that are ready to go. 
[*]Updates to the Vreal app UI including much larger play and stop buttons on recording thumbnails.
[/list]

Known Issues: [list]
[*]Heads up to all you superstar VR content creators: During Early Access, we can't guarantee that recordings you make now will be available in the long term, due to the need to regularly update the platform with new features and titles. We'll let everyone know in advance (likely through a post here on our Steam community hub) when older recordings will need to be unpublished from the app.
[*]An updated list of known issues can be found on our user wiki, [url=https://vreality.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/205914142/Known+Issues]here[/url]. [/list]

notes.title: Bob Ross and Chill?
notes.content:
Hello friends! Vreal now supports Tilt Brush. After you're done hanging out with all the happy little trees, we've got lots for you to look forward to!

In the next update, [i]everyone(!!!)[/i] will be able to make VR content with our app for certain titles (including Tilt Brush).  We’re aiming to add another game you can watch, too. While you’re waiting to make VR recordings with our app, try pulling out a camera inside a Tilt Brush recording and take a selfie! :D

Please continue to let us know what games you want to see; we’re reading every comment and are evaluating new VR titles to add to the platform. Likewise, if you have suggestions for the app, leave a comment here or head over to [url=http://support.vreal.net] support.vreal.net [/url].

See below for the latest updates and known issues. If you have questions about how Vreal mods Tilt Brush, visit our FAQ [url=https://vreality.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/261226518/How+do+Vreal+mods+work] on this page. [/url]

[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]Tilt Brush is now supported! Everyone can watch Tilt Brush recordings.
[*]All approved content creators can record Tilt Brush recordings if you have Tilt Brush installed through Steam.
[*]If you want to try using 2D cameras inside a Tilt Brush recording, pull up the menu and select “Selfie cam”. Press the button to flip the camera around and take a selfie. Photos are saved in your pictures library on your desktop.
[*]Fixed a bug where you couldn’t hear someone in your party the larger your party got. Now you can solidly hear five people in a party together. HOORAY!
[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]While in Early Access, Vreal is not yet optimized for disk usage or bandwidth consumption. If you are bandwidth or disk space challenged, you may wish to wait for our 1.0 release.
[*]Performance sometimes drops while watching a Tilt Brush recording on machines that run near the minimum spec recommended for VR. 
[*]Some brushes don't display their glow and particle effects properly when displayed through a camera.
[*]Our most up-to-date list of known issues can be found on our [url=https://vreality.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/205914142/Current+Known+Issues] user wiki. [/url]
[/list]

As always, we recommend [url=http://discord.gg/vreal]joining our Discord[/url] to party up with friends.

notes.title: RIP Pesky Bugs
notes.content:
Thank you for supporting Vreal while we’re in Early Access. Good news! Our next release on August 8 will add support for a VR title that you’ve requested. We appreciate your patience while we work on bringing new titles to the platform. In the meantime, here are the updates and bugs we squashed in this release:

[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]We’ve improved parties to make them more stable. Party on!
[*]The app can now detect if you’ve accidentally disconnected from your headset, and will kindly let you know that it happened. 
[*]When you change to another page (i.e., click “Watch”) the Vreal app minimizes the Friends panel (thanks for that feedback!).
[*]We now have thumbnails in the featured content carousel.
[*]Our privacy policy is now in the updated ‘report a bug’ dialog box. 
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]An updated list of known issues can be found on our user wiki, [url=https://vreality.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/205914142/Known+Issues]here.[/url]
[/list]

Thanks for [url=http://support.vreal.net]sending us feedback[/url], submitting bug reports, and for helping us make the app better for everyone!

We recommend [url=http://discord.gg/vreal]joining our official Discord server[/url] to party up with friends!

notes.title: Vreal update
notes.content:
Thank you for supporting us during Early Access! We hear you loud and clear on adding new games and that is our #1 priority. We’ll have an update on new games with our next release. We update the app every two weeks, so please continue to let us know what you think and what games you’d like to see! We promise more games are coming, and soon.

Thanks to everyone who submitted bug reports since we launched a couple weeks ago; you helped us squash a bunch of them. 

Below are all of the updates we’ve made since our last release and current known issues. For questions, or to request access to make content with Vreal, head over to [url=http://support.vreal.net]support.vreal.net[/url].

[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]Party time! Excellent! We fixed a bunch of bugs for watching content together in a party. Thanks to everyone who submitted bug reports!
[*]The Vreal app now asks you if you *really* want to unfriend someone when you try to unfriend them, you heartless person.
[*]A few tooltips went rogue. They have all been corralled back to their assigned pens.  
[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]An updated list of known issues can be found on our user wiki, [url=https://vreality.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/205914142/Known+Issues]here[/url].
[/list]

[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*]Vreal is not yet optimized for disk usage or bandwidth consumption. If you are bandwidth or disk space challenged, you may wish to wait for our 1.0 release.
[/list]
[b]Viewing:[/b]
[list]
[*]Opening Vreal in the SteamVR dashboard using a Vive Pro will crash the app.
[*]Streams will occasionally auto-launch without prompt. This can occur for a number of reasons, but we're aware of it.
[*]Stream will occasionally display odd behavior while watching - it may speed up, slow down, or sometimes take a long time to load and then catch up later on.
[/list]
[b]Parties:[/b]
[list]
[*]Pausing while in a party can cause a desync between party members viewing that experience. Ex: One member could be 5:00 into the recording while another could be 4:30 into the recording.
[*]The 5th member in a party is sometimes unable to communicate with other party members via voice chat.
[*]After watching one recording in a party, the leader will see a message that other party members need to download content. This message is incorrect and the recording should still launch regardless.
[*]Game audio can occasionally stop working if multiple members have been paused/unpaused.
[/list]

[b]Vreal App:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Vreal app occasionally launches with just a black screen. If this lasts more than 10 seconds, relaunch the app.
[*]The Vreal app does not scale to full screen.
[*]App performance is poor on 4K monitor.
[*]The app does not load if there is no internet connection.
[*]If you unfriend someone, you will not be able to go back and add them as a friend. 
[/list]
[b]Content creation:[/b]
[list]
[*]Previously unpublished/deleted content still displays in the dashboard and on the Watch/Home pages of the app. (These will not be visible by other people, and are only visible for the content creator)
[*]Recording 2D content using cameras in Arizona Sunshine can cause performance issues. 
[/list]

notes.title: Vreal is now in Early Access! *\o/*
notes.content:
Vreal is now in Early Access! HUZZAH! 

To get started, we recommend checking out the discussions tab on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/440120/discussions/]Community Hub [/url]. We'll post there regularly with product updates, announcements, and release notes. You can also find us on [url=http://discord.gg/vreal]Discord [/url]or [url=http://www.twitter.com/vrealofficial]Twitter[/url].

[h1]General release notes & known issues:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Vreal is not yet optimized for disk usage or bandwidth consumption. If you are bandwidth or disk space challenged, you may wish to wait for our 1.0 release.
[/list]
[h1]Viewing:[/h1]
[*]Opening Vreal in the SteamVR dashboard using a Vive Pro will crash the app.
[*]Streams will occasionally auto-launch without prompt. This can occur for a number of reasons, but we're aware of it.
[*]Stream will occasionally display odd behavior while watching - it may speed up, slow down, or sometimes take a long time to load and then catch up later on.[/list]
[h1]Parties:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Pausing while in a party can cause desync between party members viewing experience. Ex: One member could be 5:00 into the recording while another could be 4:30 into the recording.
[*]The 5th member in a party is sometimes unable to communicate with other party members via voice chat.
[*]After watching one recording in a party, the leader will see a message that other party members need to download content. This message is incorrect and the recording should still launch regardless.
[*]Game audio can occasionally stop working if multiple members have been paused/unpaused.[/list]
[h1]Vreal App:[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Vreal app occasionally launches with just a black screen. If this lasts more than 10 seconds, relaunch the app.
[*]The Vreal app does not scale to full screen.
[*]App performance is poor on 4K monitor.
[*]The app does not load if there is no internet connection.
[*]Report a bug feature fails to submit a report if you just created or watched an Arizona Sunshine recording. [/list]

To submit a bug or to provide feedback, you can visit our support site [url=http://support.vreal.net] here[/url].

Welcome to the Vreal community! :)

Cheers,
--the Vreal team
